spans.s:
The initial ष् of an affix is indicatory.

Terms: इत्

त् is substituted for the final स् of a root before an आर्द्धधातुक affix beginning with a स्।

Terms: त् substitution

स is substituted for the स् after the reduplicate of षण् Desiderative of the Causatives of 1. स्विद् 2. स्वद् and 3. सह्।

Terms: षत्व change
